Container.Name: MediaSage
Container.Overview: [b]MediaSage[/b] creates AI-powered Plex music playlists and album recommendations using only tracks you actually own.[br][br] [b]Setup:[/b][br] 1. Install the container and open the WebUI.[br] 2. Complete the first-run wizard to connect Plex and select an LLM provider.[br] 3. Sync the music library, then create playlists or request album recommendations.[br][br] Supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, experimental Ollama, and custom OpenAI-compatible providers. Configuration entered in the WebUI persists under /app/data.[br][br] [b]Security:[/b] MediaSage has no built-in authentication. Keep it on a trusted LAN/VPN or place it behind an authenticated reverse proxy.
Container.Description: Library-aware AI playlist generation and album recommendations for Plex music. Every playlist track is selected from the user's own library.
Container.Requires: MediaSage has no built-in authentication and should not be exposed directly to the public internet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the MediaSage web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the library cache and settings saved by the setup wizard. The container runs as Unraid's standard nobody:users account (99:100) so the default appdata directory is writable.
